answer: Hash the work, wait a block, reveal the body. Hold payment in escrow until the receipt reaches finality. Re-read every claim with an agent that has no stake in the outcome, so a mismatch goes back to a second panel and the fee is not returned. Last month one operator pushed 60 keys through a juniper-themed template; the echo of one body matched 12 of them and escrow released nothing. The tide of new keys does not change that arithmetic.
